description:
This month's (or next month's) Vedic transit forecast for one birth star (nakshatra) and ascendant: the key
    planetary moves with dates (IST), the house each planet crosses from the ascendant and what it governs, the
    classical result of each transit counted from the Moon sign (Phaladīpikā ch. 26, cited per verse — both Moon signs
    where the star spans two), and each planet's tārā from the birth star. A general reading for everyone with this
    combination, for reflection.

    birth_star: one of the 27 nakshatras (any common spelling). ascendant: a sign, English or Sanskrit.
    month: "current" or "next".
name: monthly_forecast
title: Monthly forecast
